text: {"label":"Assessing and Treating Aggression and Destructive Behavior","definition":"Research on functional analysis, function-based treatment, safety, and relapse (such as resurgence after treatment) for aggression and other destructive behavior, including synthesized contingencies, noncontingent reinforcement, schedule thinning, and protective equipment.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on aggression and destructive behavior in applied settings, unlike broad overviews of problem-behavior treatment or basic laboratory work on operant reinforcement, response–reinforcer relations, and behavioral variability."}
